title: dev-next: runs on one computer test on the newest main and cap their test copies
story: A new project's starter rules file now has a row saying how its full suite takes a number of test copies, or none. /dev-next now merges the newest main before its checks instead of after them, refuses to merge a branch that has fallen behind main, and works out how many test copies to run from the computer's cores, the runs in progress and the free memory.

checks.criterion: init writes the new test-copies row into the starter CLAUDE.md
checks.steps: Make an empty git folder, run bash orion.sh init --project <tmp> --update-mode ask, then open <tmp>/CLAUDE.md.
checks.expected: The commands table has a Test copies row reading TBD.

checks.criterion: A filled copies row is not reported as an unfilled slot
checks.steps: In that project, replace CLAUDE.md with the import line plus a row '| Test copies | `-n <copies>` |', then run bash orion.sh verify --project <tmp>.
